key: They're coming back. I know they're coming back!
en: They're coming back. I know they're coming back!
ja: あいつら、また戻ってくる。絶対戻ってくるわ!

key: Muggers already took one of my babies and I know they'll come back!
en: Muggers already took one of my babies and I know they'll come back!
ja: 強盗にもう子供の一匹を取られたのよ、また戻ってくるに決まってる!

key: Get out! I don't want to risk anything happening! Please go!
en: Get out! I don't want to risk anything happening!  Please go!
ja: 出てって! これ以上何か起きるのは嫌なの! お願い、行って!

key: Thank you so much for saving my precious Pokémon!
en: Thank you so much for saving my precious Pokémon!
ja: わたしの大切なポケモンを助けてくれて、本当にありがとう!

key: I don't know what I would have done...
en: I don't know what I would have done...
ja: どうしていいか分からなかったわ……

key: But what if they come back?
en: But what if they come back?
ja: でも、また戻ってきたらどうしよう?

key: They'll definitely come back... I couldn't bear for my precious baby to fall into the hands of thugs like them!
en: They'll definitely come back... I couldn't bear for my precious baby to fall into the hands of thugs like them!
ja: 絶対また戻ってくるわ……大切な子があんな悪党どもの手に落ちるなんて、耐えられない!

key: I know! You! Please keep it safe and eliminate those people!
en: I know! You! Please keep it safe and eliminate those people!
ja: そうだ! あなた! この子を守って、あの連中をやっつけてちょうだい!

key: Will you? You saved it once, I'm sure I can trust you to watch over it!
en: Will you? You saved it once, I'm sure I can trust you to watch over it!
ja: やってくれる? 一度助けてくれたんだもの、見守ってくれるって信じてるわ!

key: I beg you keep my precious safe.
en: I beg you keep my precious safe.
ja: お願いだから、大切な子を守ってあげて。

key: Everything is going to be all right...
en: Everything is going to be all right...
ja: きっと大丈夫……

key: Life has been so much more relaxing now that the crime rates around town have dropped!
en: Life has been so much more relaxing now that the crime rates around town have dropped!
ja: 街の犯罪率が下がって、生活がずっと落ち着いたわ!

key: I no longer have to worry about suspicious people coming in and taking my property or precious pets.
en: I no longer have to worry about suspicious people coming in and taking my property or precious pets.
ja: 怪しい人が入ってきて、財産や大切なペットを奪っていくんじゃないかって、もう心配しなくていいの。

key: And you know who it's all thanks to?
en: And you know who it's all thanks to?
ja: それが誰のおかげか分かる?

key: That wonderful, strong Trainer who's been all over trying to help Reborn...
en: That wonderful, strong Trainer who's been all over trying to help Reborn...
ja: リボーンを助けようと、あちこち駆け回っている、あの素晴らしくて強いトレーナー……

key: Adrienn!
en: Adrienn!
ja: アドリエンヌよ!

key: Oh! It's you! You're the one I entrusted my Igglybuff to!
en: Oh! It's you! You're the one I entrusted my Igglybuff to!
ja: あら! あなただったのね! ププリンを預けた人!

key: How is it doing? Say--
en: How is it doing? Say--
ja: 元気にしてる? そうだ――

key: Is there any chance I could have it back?
en: Is there any chance I could have it back?
ja: 返してもらえたりする?

key: The crime rate in Reborn City has dropped so much, I no longer have to worry about my Pokémon being taken away.
en: The crime rate in Reborn City has dropped so much, I no longer have to worry about my Pokémon being taken away.
ja: リボーンシティの犯罪率がすごく下がったから、ポケモンを奪われる心配ももうしなくていいの。

key: And I did say I was only lending it to you!
en: And I did say I was only lending it to you!
ja: それに、あくまで貸すだけって言ったはずよ!

key: Uh, I did say that, right?
en: Uh, I did say that, right?
ja: ええと、そう言ったわよね?

key: Even if I didn't, it was implied. So please give me my Igglybuff back!
en: Even if I didn't, it was implied. So please give me my Igglybuff back!
ja: 言ってなかったとしても、暗にそう伝わってたはず。だから、ププリンを返してちょうだい!

key: That's definitely not my Igglybuff! I want what's mine!
en: That's definitely not my Igglybuff! I want what's mine!
ja: それは絶対にわたしのププリンじゃないわ! わたしの子が欲しいの!

key: Ahh, so you have it after all. I'm so happy!
en: Ahh, so you have it after all. I'm so happy!
ja: ああ、やっぱり持っていてくれたのね。すごくうれしいわ!

key: Thank you for taking good care of it!
en: Thank you for taking good care of it!
ja: ちゃんとお世話してくれてありがとう!

key: For keeping my precious safe, please take these!
en: For keeping my precious safe, please take these!
ja: 大切な子を守ってくれたお礼に、これを受け取って!

key: I'll never let my precious out of my sight again.
en: I'll never let my precious out of my sight again.
ja: もう二度と、大切な子を目の届かないところに置いたりしないわ。

key: Perhaps I should just learn to have it fight for itself...
en: Perhaps I should just learn to have it fight for itself...
ja: いっそ、自分で戦えるように育てるべきかしら……

key: Ah! But then it wouldn't be as cute!
en: Ah! But then it wouldn't be as cute!
ja: あっ! でもそうしたら、かわいさが減っちゃうかも!

key: WOMAN: Help!
en: WOMAN: Help!
ja: 女性: 助けて!

key: SUSPICIOUS MAN: No one's going to help you, Miss. This Pokémon belongs to Team Meteor now.
en: SUSPICIOUS MAN: No one's going to help you, Miss.  This Pokémon belongs to Team Meteor now.
ja: 怪しい男: 誰も助けになんて来ませんよ、お嬢さん。このポケモンは、もうチームメテオのものだ。

key: SUSPICIOUS WOMAN: ...What? You found us after all?
en: SUSPICIOUS WOMAN: ...What? You found us after all?
ja: 怪しい女: ……何? やっぱり見つかったの?

key: SUSPICIOUS MAN: Is that so... Then I'm afraid you'll just have to be eliminated.
en: SUSPICIOUS MAN: Is that so... Then I'm afraid you'll just have to be eliminated.
ja: 怪しい男: そうか……それなら、残念だが排除させてもらうしかないな。

key: DUO: This is an attack.
en: DUO: This is an attack.
ja: 二人: これは攻撃だ。

key: So brace for impact.
en: So brace for impact.
ja: 衝撃に備えろ。

key: To eliminate this infestation!
en: To eliminate this infestation!
ja: この害虫を排除するために!

key: To restore the art of God's own nation!
en: To restore the art of God's own nation!
ja: 神の御国の芸術を取り戻すために!

key: To break apart the world above!
en: To break apart the world above!
ja: 上なる世界を打ち砕くために!

key: To find what lies beneath truth and love!
en: To find what lies beneath truth and love!
ja: 真実と愛の下に横たわるものを見つけるために!

key: Team Meteor!
en: Team Meteor!
ja: チームメテオ!

key: Resonating with the eternal light!
en: Resonating with the eternal light!
ja: 永遠の光と共鳴する!

key: Run away now, don't try to fight!
en: Run away now, don't try to fight!
ja: 今すぐ逃げろ、戦おうとするな!

key: For justice! That's right!
en: For justice! That's right!
ja: 正義のために! その通り!

key: How could we fail...
en: How could we fail...
ja: どうして失敗したんだ……

key: I knew this would be a problem!
en: I knew this would be a problem!
ja: やっぱり問題になると思ったのよ!

key: SUSPICIOUS MAN: ...
en: SUSPICIOUS MAN: ...
ja: 怪しい男: ……

key: If we continue, we jeopardize our main objective.
en: If we continue, we jeopardize our main objective.
ja: このまま続ければ、本来の目的が危うくなる。

key: Retreat.
en: Retreat.
ja: 撤退だ。

key: Ig! Igglybuff!
en: Ig! Igglybuff!
ja: プリ! ププリン!

key: Igglybuff looks frightened.
en: Igglybuff looks frightened.
ja: ププリンはひるえているようだ。

key: Will you take Igglybuff with you?
en: Will you take Igglybuff with you?
ja: ププリンを連れていきますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
